title: Cluster teams by archetype makeup
author: andrew
rationale: Represent each team-season by its players' archetype composition and cluster teams.
question: Do teams fall into distinct compositional styles by their players' archetype makeup?
method_summary: Per team-season, counts+proportions of 9 archetypes (18 feats); agglomerative K by silhouette, HDBSCAN as robustness check.
key_findings: Team compositions are a continuum, not distinct clusters (best silhouette 0.16; HDBSCAN 2 clusters+noise).
Descriptive K=7 partition shows defender-heavy, elite-attacker, and attack-heavy tendencies.
Caveat: clusters partly track season (archetype prevalence shifts); within-season normalization is the recommended follow-up.
